0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-7, 3-2 on the road, 11th in the East) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 3-2 at home, 10th in the West), with Indiana coming off a loss and sitting 4 games back in the Central. The teams have met once this season, with the Pacers losing 121-105 in Indianapolis on October 23, and Indiana also lost both meetings in 2025-26. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton, Ben Sheppard and Johnny Furphy, all out, and T.J. McConnell is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and a game-time decision, while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, who are all out.
